title: Blue Dragon Girl
description: A young woman with short silver hair and blue streaks stands in a dynamic pose against a solid pink background. She wears a form-fitting blue armored outfit with glowing blue circuit-like patterns, matching gauntlets and boots, and has a living blue dragon coiled around her shoulders and waist with its head resting near her shoulder.
prompt: A confident young woman with short silver hair featuring a bright blue streak, standing in a dynamic three-quarter pose against a solid magenta background. She wears intricate blue futuristic armored bodysuit with glowing cyan circuit patterns, matching gauntlets and heavy boots. A sleek blue dragon is coiled around her body with its head resting on her left shoulder. Sharp detailed digital painting style with dramatic lighting.
